title: Too much of a good thing -- when knowledge distillation promotes overfitting, and how to avoid it
abstract: arXiv:2608.23752v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The growing size of Convolutional Neural Networks has led to increasingly large and costly models. Knowledge Distillation (KD) addresses this by transferring knowledge from a large network (teacher) to a small one (student), also reducing the training data required. KD is traditionally applied only at the network's final output. However, its behaviour when applied at intermediate network layers has received little attention. This raises the question of whether intermediate block-wise KD, which provides supervision throughout the network, could offer an advantage under specific conditions, such as few instances per class, which is common in fine-grained datasets. This work proposes a student design based on simple, homogeneous blocks mirroring those of the teacher, distilling knowledge between corresponding blocks. Across eleven datasets, we show that on classic datasets, distilling only the last block is sufficient -- and often best--,

translated_title: 好事过头反成坏事——知识蒸馏何时会促进过拟合，以及如何避免
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23752v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：卷积神经网络规模的不断增大导致模型日益庞大且成本高昂。知识蒸馏（KD）通过将知识从大型网络（教师）转移到小型网络（学生）来解决这一问题，同时减少了所需的训练数据。传统上，KD仅应用于网络的最终输出。然而，当应用于网络中间层时，其行为很少受到关注。这引出了一个问题：在特定条件下（例如每个类别样本很少，这在细粒度数据集中很常见），提供整个网络监督的中间块级KD是否可能带来优势。本工作提出了一种基于与教师网络简单同质块对应的学生设计，在相应块之间进行知识蒸馏。在十一个数据集上，我们表明在经典数据集上，仅蒸馏最后一个块就足够了——且通常效果最佳——
tldr: 本研究提出一种基于同质块的知识蒸馏学生设计，发现中间层蒸馏在数据稀缺时可能过拟合，而仅蒸馏最后块在经典数据集上通常最优。
en_tdlr: This work proposes a homogeneous-block-based student design for knowledge distillation, showing that intermediate-layer distillation can overfit with scarce data, while distilling only the last block is often optimal on classic datasets.
